title: Indlela Yokulanda Amavidiyo Nezithombe ze-Pinterest ku-Gallery
description: Indlela yokulanda amavidiyo nezithombe ze-Pinterest ku-gallery yefoni noma ku-laptop mahhala, ngaphandle kwe-app nokungena. Landela izinyathelo ezilula.
body:
Wake wathola ividiyo yeresiphi, umbono wokuhlobisa, noma isifundo esifushane ku-Pinterest wase ufuna ukuyibuka futhi ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi? Isici sokulondoloza se-Pinterest sifaka i-Pin ebhodini ngaphakathi kwe-app, ngakho ifayela alingeni ngempela ku-gallery yefoni yakho. Kule ndatshana uzofunda indlela yokulanda amavidiyo e-Pinterest nezithombe ze-Pinterest uwafake ku-gallery kalula, mahhala, ngaphandle kwe-app eyengeziwe, nangaphandle kokungena ngemvume.

Ithuluzi esizolisebenzisa yi-I Need Save, isilandi esisebenza kuwebhu ongasivula ngqo ku-browser efonini noma ku-laptop. Ngaphandle kwe-Pinterest, i-I Need Save ingasetshenziselwa nokuthunyelwe okusesidlangalaleni okuvela ku-TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), nakwezinye izinkundla.

Okudingeka ukulungiselele

  • Ilinki ye-Pin ofuna ukuyilondoloza. Qiniseka ukuthi leyo Pin isesidlangalaleni.
  • Noma iyiphi i-browser, isibonelo i-Chrome ku-Android noma i-Safari ku-iPhone.
  • Uxhumano lwe-inthanethi oluzinzile, ikakhulukazi kumavidiyo amade.

Akudingeki uvule i-akhawunti ku-I Need Save futhi akudingeki ufake noma iyiphi i-app.

Indlela yokulanda amavidiyo e-Pinterest efonini

Izinyathelo ziyafana ku-Android naku-iPhone:

  1. Vula i-app ye-Pinterest bese ufuna i-Pin yevidiyo oyifunayo.
  2. Thepha inkinobho ethi Yabelana (Share), bese ukhetha Kopisha ilinki (Copy link).
  3. Vula i-browser bese uvakashela ikhasi lokulanda le-I Need Save.
  4. Namathisela ilinki ebhokisini elikhona, noma vele uthephe inkinobho ethi Namathisela.
  5. Cindezela okuthi Landa bese ulinda kancane kuze kuvele izinketho zamafayela.
  6. Khetha inketho oyifunayo, isibonelo ividiyo ngekhwalithi ethile.

Uma inkinobho iguquka ithi Iyalungisa…, ungalivali ikhasi okwamanje. Kusho ukuthi ividiyo iyacutshungulwa, isibonelo ividiyo nomsindo wayo kuyahlanganiswa noma i-stream iguqulelwa ku-MP4. Uma sekuqediwe, ukulanda kuzoqala ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Indlela yokulondoloza izithombe ze-Pinterest

Kuma-Pin ayizithombe, indlela icishe ifane. Kopisha ilinki ye-Pin, uyinamathisele ku-I Need Save, bese ucindezela okuthi Landa. Ohlwini lwezinketho, khetha Isithombe noma Isithonjana. Le nketho ilusizo futhi uma udinga kuphela isithombe sekhava se-Pin yevidiyo, isibonelo njengenkomba yedizayini yakho siqu.

Ukukhetha ikhwalithi yevidiyo efanele

Ngemuva kokucindezela okuthi Landa, uvame ukubona izinketho ezimbalwa zekhwalithi ezifana no-360p, 720p, noma 1080p. Izinketho ezivelayo zincike kuvidiyo yangempela, ngakho akuwona wonke ama-Pin anenketho ye-1080p.

  • 360p ifanelekile uma idatha yakho incane noma indawo yokugcina yefoni isicishe yagcwala.
  • 720p iyinketho elinganiselayo phakathi kokucaca nobukhulu befayela.
  • 1080p icace kakhulu, ifanele ukubukwa esikrinini esikhulu.

Ungafunda incazelo ephelele kundatshana ethi umehluko wekhwalithi yevidiyo engu-360p, 720p, ne-1080p.

Ngaphandle kwevidiyo, kukhona nenketho ethi Umsindo. Ungathatha umsindo ngekhwalithi yangempela, noma i-MP3 ye-192 kbps eguqulwe evidiyweni. Kuwusizo uma okufunayo kuwumculo wangemuva we-Pin kuphela.

Amafayela e-Pinterest alondolozwa kuphi?

Indawo yefayela incike kudivayisi oyisebenzisayo:

  • I-Android nekhompyutha: ifayela lingena kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe). I-app ye-Gallery kwesinye isikhathi idinga isikhashana ngaphambi kokulibonisa.
  • I-iPhone ne-iPad (Safari): ifayela lingena ku-app ethi Files → Downloads (Okulandiwe). Ukuze ividiyo ingene ku-app ethi Photos, vula ividiyo ku-Files, thepha okuthi Share (Yabelana), bese ukhetha Save Video (Londoloza Ividiyo).

Uma usadidekile ukuthola ifayela, landela umhlahlandlela othi lapho amafayela alandiwe alondolozwa khona ku-Android naku-iPhone.

Amafayela athunyelwa ngqo esuka ku-Pinterest aye kudivayisi yakho futhi awagcinwa kuseva ye-I Need Save. Ngakho, gcina amafayela abalulekile endaweni ozoyithola kalula futhi.

Uma ukulanda ku-Pinterest kwehluleka

Kunezinto ezimbalwa ezingenza inqubo yehluleke:

  • I-Pin ivela ku-akhawunti eyimfihlo noma ibonakala kuphela ngemuva kokungena ngemvume.
  • Okuqukethwe kukhawulelwe ezifundeni ezithile.
  • Ilinki enamathiselwe ayiphelele noma ikopishwe kabi.

Zama ukukopisha futhi ilinki ngqo enkinobhweni ethi Yabelana, bese uphinda inqubo. Khumbula ukuthi okuqukethwe okuyimfihlo, okudinga ukungena ngemvume, nokukhawulelwe ngokwesifunda ngempela akukwazi ukulandwa.

Kusebenzise ngobuhlakani

Ama-Pin amaningi aqukethe imisebenzi yabanye abantu, njengezithombe, imidwebo, noma amavidiyo enziwe ngabadali. Landa ukuze usebenzise wena kuphela, isibonelo ukulondoloza njengenkomba noma ukubuka ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Uma ufuna ukukuphinda ukuthumele, cela imvume kumnikazi kuqala futhi ubalule igama lakhe.

Imibuzo evame ukubuzwa

Ingabe ukulanda amavidiyo e-Pinterest ku-I Need Save kumahhala?

Yebo, kumahhala. Vele uvule isayithi ku-browser, ngaphandle kwe-app nangaphandle kokungena ngemvume.

Ingasetshenziswa yini ku-laptop?

Yebo. Vula i-Pin ku-browser ye-laptop, kopisha ilinki yayo, bese uyinamathisela ku-I Need Save. Ifayela lizongena kufolda ethi Downloads.

Kungani ividiyo ingaveli ngokushesha ku-gallery?

Ku-Android, i-Gallery kwesinye isikhathi idinga isikhashana ukuze ivuselele uhlu lwamafayela. Ku-iPhone, ividiyo kudingeka iqale ilondolozwe isuka ku-app ethi Files iye ku-Photos ngemenyu ethi Share.
